keyLimits.en: Includes AI Copilot with unlimited agentic AI and no usage caps, 100K Workato integration credits, incident/change/problem/request management, asset management, SLA management, dashboards and BI analytics
Starts at 20 agents; adds sandbox environment, tailor-made AI agents, advanced analytics, 300K Workato credits, gold support

cautions.en: Price also depends on the number of managed assets (workstations, servers, mobile devices), not agent seats alone.
Free trial requires no credit card, but there is no permanent free plan.

capabilities.en: ITSM platform covering incident, change, problem and request management with ITIL-aligned workflows.
Built-in AI Copilot for agents and end users, plus asset/IT inventory management.

limitations.en: No public list price beyond the Professional tier; Enterprise requires a custom quote starting at 20 agents.
No permanent free plan; only a time-limited free trial is offered.

reason.en: Direct ITSM competitor with a comparable help desk, asset management and ITIL workflow feature set.
